title: Measuring Iterative Temporal Reasoning with Time Puzzles
abstract: arXiv:2601.07148v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tool use, such as web search, has become a standard capability even in freely available large language models (LLMs). However, existing benchmarks evaluate temporal reasoning mainly in static, non-tool-using settings, which poorly reflect how LLMs perform temporal reasoning in practice. We introduce Time Puzzles, a constraint-based date inference task for evaluating iterative temporal reasoning with tools. Each puzzle combines factual temporal anchors with (cross-cultural) calendar relations and may admit one or multiple valid dates. The puzzles are algorithmically generated, enabling controlled and continual evaluation. Across 13 LLMs, even the best model (GPT-5) achieves only 55.3% accuracy without tools, despite using easily searchable facts. translated_title: 用时间谜题衡量迭代式时间推理
translated_abstract: 工具使用（如网络搜索）已成为免费可用的大语言模型（LLM）的标准能力。然而，现有的基准测试主要在静态的、不使用工具的设置下评估时间推理，这难以反映大语言模型在实践中进行时间推理的真实表现。我们提出了Time Puzzles（时间谜题），这是一个基于约束的日期推断任务，用于评估结合工具的迭代式时间推理。每个谜题将事实性时间锚点与（跨文化的）日历关系相结合，可能存在一个或多个有效日期。这些谜题由算法生成，能够实现受控且持续的评估。在13个大语言模型的实验中，即使是最强的模型（GPT-5），在不使用工具的情况下也仅达到55.3%的准确率，尽管其中涉及的事实很容易搜索到。虽然网络搜索能够提升性能，但当约束条件被改写为明确的日期、无需进行事实查询时，模型的表现会显著更好。这些结果揭示了……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于约束的日期推断任务“时间谜题”，用于评估大语言模型结合工具进行迭代式时间推理的能力，发现即使最强的GPT-5在不使用工具时准确率也仅有55.3%，且将约束改写为明确日期后模型表现显著更好。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Time Puzzles, a constraint-based date inference task for evaluating iterative temporal reasoning with tools, showing that even the best model GPT-5 achieves only 55.3% accuracy without tools, and models perform substantially better when constraints are rewritten with explicit dates.
